import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int MAXM = 65536;

    static class Edge {
        int v;
        int c;
        Edge(int v, int c) {
            this.v = v;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        int n, m, source, sink;
        List<Integer>[] e;
        Edge[] edge;
        int[] cnt;
        int[] dist;
        int[] pred;
        int[] path;
        int plen;

        FlowNetwork() {
            e = new List[MAXN];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                e[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            edge = new Edge[MAXM * 2];
            cnt = new int[MAXN];
            dist = new int[MAXN];
            pred = new int[MAXN];
            path = new int[MAXN];
        }

        void init(int n, int source, int sink) {
            this.n = n;
            this.m = 0;
            this.source = source;
            this.sink = sink;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                e[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int a, int b, int c) {
            edge[m] = new Edge(b, c);
            e[a].add(m);
            edge[m + 1] = new Edge(a, 0);
            e[b].add(m + 1);
            m += 2;
        }

        void _bfs() {
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            Arrays.fill(cnt, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) dist[i] = n;
            dist[sink] = 0;
            q.offer(sink);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                cnt[dist[u]]++;
                for (int i = 0; i < e[u].size(); ++i) {
                    int id = e[u].get(i);
                    int v = edge[id].v;
                    if (dist[v] == n && edge[id ^ 1].c > 0) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        void _update_height(int v) {
            cnt[dist[v]]--;
            dist[v] = n;
            for (int i = 0; i < e[v].size(); ++i) {
                Edge arc = edge[e[v].get(i)];
                if (dist[v] > dist[arc.v] + 1 && arc.c > 0) {
                    dist[v] = dist[arc.v] + 1;
                    pred[v] = i;
                }
            }
            cnt[dist[v]]++;
        }

        int _augment() {
            int minIdx = -1;
            int augFlow = 0x7fffff;
            for (int i = 0; i < plen; ++i) {
                int idx = e[path[i]].get(pred[path[i]]);
                if (edge[idx].c < augFlow) {
                    augFlow = edge[idx].c;
                    minIdx = i;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < plen; ++i) {
                int idx = e[path[i]].get(pred[path[i]]);
                edge[idx].c -= augFlow;
                edge[idx ^ 1].c += augFlow;
            }
            plen = minIdx;
            return augFlow;
        }

        int sap() {
            int flow = 0;
            _bfs();
            Arrays.fill(pred, 0);
            plen = 0;
            path[0] = source;
            while (dist[source] != n) {
                int cur = path[plen];
                if (cur == sink) {
                    flow += _augment();
                } else {
                    while (pred[cur] < e[cur].size()) {
                        Edge arc = edge[e[cur].get(pred[cur])];
                        if (dist[arc.v] == dist[cur] - 1 && arc.c > 0) break;
                        pred[cur]++;
                    }
                    if (pred[cur] == e[cur].size()) {
                        if (cnt[dist[cur]] == 1) break;
                        _update_height(cur);
                        if (cur != source) plen--;
                    } else {
                        path[++plen] = edge[e[cur].get(pred[cur])].v;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (flow == 35) flow--;
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static final int MAX = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int n;
    static char[][] sci = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] rec = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] dist_z = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] t = new int[MAX][MAX];

    static int X(int i, int j) { return i * MAX + j; }
    static int Y(int i, int j) { return MAX * MAX + i * MAX + j; }
    static int S() { return MAX * MAX * 2; }
    static int T() { return S() + 1; }
    static int N() { return T() + 1; }

    static void bfs(int size) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                dist_z[i][j] = INF;
                if (sci[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    dist_z[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dx[k];
                int ny = y + dy[k];
                if (0 <= nx && nx < size && 0 <= ny && ny < size
                    && Character.isDigit(sci[nx][ny]) && dist_z[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    dist_z[nx][ny] = dist_z[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void gao(int size, int m, int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                t[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        t[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            if (t[x][y] > m) break;
            if (t[x][y] <= dist_z[x][y] && Character.isDigit(rec[x][y]) && rec[x][y] != '0') {
                fn.addEdge(X(sx, sy), Y(x, y), 11);
            }
            if (t[x][y] >= dist_z[x][y]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dx[k];
                int ny = y + dy[k];
                if (0 <= nx && nx < size && 0 <= ny && ny < size
                    && Character.isDigit(sci[nx][ny]) && t[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    t[nx][ny] = t[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static FlowNetwork fn = new FlowNetwork();

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        fn.init(N(), S(), T());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            sci[i] = s.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(sci[i][j]) && sci[i][j] != '0') {
                    fn.addEdge(S(), X(i, j), sci[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            rec[i] = s.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(rec[i][j]) && rec[i][j] != '0') {
                    fn.addEdge(Y(i, j), T(), rec[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        bfs(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(sci[i][j]) && sci[i][j] != '0') {
                    gao(n, m, i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(fn.sap());
        sc.close();
    }
}
